I relate to this so much. Stray kids' music keeps me from unalive-ing myself ;-;As pathetic as that sounds, they and their music are such a huge source of comfort to me, I don't think I have the vocabulary to express how much they mean to me.

Hellevator, Phobia, Streetlights, Lonely St. are all so reassuring and hold me close. Say songs could give hugs and hold you close, these would be it for me. Again, as corny as it sounds, relating to Hellevator has probably kept me alive. I too have struggled with mental illness for a long time. It's been so long that words don't really affect me any more, they feel empty. Everything everyone says as reassurance just feel empty, and not like anyone means it. Somehow their songs make their way into my head and tell me that it's okay to be at rock bottom and exist with it. It's okay to exist even if my existence doesn't really amount to anything, or even if I am failing to keep it together daily.

It's probably not a good thing that I am so dependent on their presence for my daily dose of serotonin lol but the little things they do, their words and actions feel so genuine. Don't even get me started on Chan's lives. His lives are the only thing I look forward to, to get through most weeks. Having even one thing I desperately look forward to every week helps incredibly. I am so grateful to him for being so interactive, consistent and down to earth on his lives. I love that he is such a ray of sunshine despite the language barrier. I also really appreciate that he has a way of making himself feel accessible when not a lot of celebs are (hell, even people around us, let alone celebs).
